name: command
lore:
### The Edict of One: *Command*

To cast *Command* is to briefly impose the sovereignty of your soul upon another. As the incantation—a singular, resonant word—is uttered, the air around the speaker’s throat shimmers with a heavy, golden vibration. The caster feels the Weave not as a flow, but as a sudden, taut tether snapping into place, hooking into the target’s very volition.

Visually, the victim’s eyes often glaze with a dull, metallic sheen, their limbs moving with the jerky precision of a marionette. It is a sharp, surgical strike of enchantment that brooks no dissent.

**Legend of the First Word**
The archives of the Iron Library credit the discovery to Archmage Kaelen the Just. During the Great Schism, Kaelen found himself unarmed before a charging titan. Eschewing complex evocations, he reached into the raw quintessence of Law and shouted, "*Grovel!*" The titan collapsed so violently the earth cracked. Kaelen proved that a single, disciplined will is heavier than any mountain. Use it wisely, traveler; a word can be sharper than a blade.
